description: A small light-green bowl sits near the center, with several small toys in front of it, including a yellow banana-shaped piece, two dark cherries, a small duck, and other tiny items. The right hand moves in from the right toward the banana-shaped toy, grips it as the right-hand object, lifts it up and left toward the bowl, then lowers it into the bowl and releases it, leaving the banana inside while the hand pulls back.
